verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline above its 'Every mixed case' subline and reads left to right in a sensible order. However, about 100px of empty space sits on the left, and the fine print 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' is squeezed into a 4-line column jammed against the circle and product at the right edge. B is worse: 'Every mixed case.' is crammed into a narrow 3-line stack wedged between the headline and the CTA, with no room on either side. The purple circle is cut off from the product and stranded alone at the far right. The fine print is also squeezed into a 4-line column, which leaves the right side scattered and unbalanced.
